description: Fork of exp203 (single LUT after attn, LN-pre, val_bpb=1.948 @ 1800). Two changes: (1) LUT shape nap 6->8, tph 4096->1536 (=384*4); (2) split Q/K/V input -- Q,K see x WITH per-layer pos, V sees x WITHOUT pos, both through the same LN and the same V2D. Hypothesis: V should carry pure content; Q/K positional info enables relative attention but values shouldn't be position-coloured before mixing. Per-block LUT 12.58M, total ~125M. Pair coverage 16.7%.
